## [Unreleased]

### Added

- Feature `simd`: NEON and runtime-detected AVX2 + FMA dot products with a scalar fallback; public `distance` module with the kernels and `backend()`.
- `Quant::I8Rerank`: `i8` graph walk with exact `f32` rescoring of the best `k * rerank` candidates; new field `Params::rerank` (default 4) and `VecDb::set_rerank`. Files in this mode (quantization code 2) cannot be read by older builds. An unknown quantization code is now an error instead of being read as `F32`.
- `VecDb::insert_batch`: validated batch insert saved in one transaction; feature `parallel` runs it on rayon.
- `VecDb::search_filtered`: predicate / allow-list search applied inside the layer-0 beam.
- `VecDb::delete` (tombstones, persisted in a new `vdb_tomb` table), `VecDb::tombstones` and `VecDb::compact` (rebuild from live vectors in one rewriting transaction).
- `Params::for_recall(Recall, Quant)`: `m`, `ef_construction` and `ef_search` presets for recall@10 of about 0.90 or 0.95, from the recorded benchmark.

- Tests that a reopen returns bit-identical hits in every quantization mode; the entry point and node levels were already persisted (`vdb_meta` key 4, per-node level count).

### Fixed

- `insert_batch` with `parallel` inserts the first page serially; a parallel start on a near-empty graph linked poorly.
- `save` rolls back on error and keeps its pending pages for the next save, instead of dropping them and leaving the transaction open.
